[EVENT] User is thinking of making falafel as one of the Middle Eastern options.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant provided tips for making crispy falafel: use high-quality dry chickpeas, don't over-process, use the right flour, chill the mixture, shape wisely, double-fry, and drain excess oil.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant provided tips for fluffy falafel: don't over-mix, use the right binding agents, don't overcrowd, and don't overcook.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant suggested serving falafel hot with toppings like tahini sauce, hummus, lettuce, tomatoes, and pickles.
